items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Bill Mann, he and I was very close... So we were very good buddies, very good friends and all that.

ctx.x: Yeah, because I had a job to go on the road with this man. The old money was bigger. Bill Mann, he and I was very close. He wanted me to leave because lot of times in the morning I'd go down there, take his bank book to the bank and deposit it in his, you know, bank, and then the checking account, we'd pick up the money and then come back for the bartenders and wages they had for the night. So we were very good buddies, very good friends and all that.
Well, how -- when did Minton die?
